2 June
Cotton On reported a theft as the offender boarded a bus — the evening team stopped the bus, recovered the stolen goods and returned them to the store the same hour.
9 June

A man rampaging through Glassons — throwing clothing, slamming mannequins and abusing staff — was physically guided out and calmed by guards; Police arrested him and guards preserved the evidence scene. Staff sought the team out the next day to thank them.
11 June
Auckland Council reported a suspicious bag near Peter Alexander — the person of interest was located within four minutes and the matter cleared with a consensual bag check.
16 June
Whimsical Blu's stolen stock was spotted on Elliott Street minutes after the call — retrieved and returned to the store the same afternoon.
21 June
Overnight, the team distributed ASG-sponsored hot meals to rough sleepers along Queen Street — guardianship that builds the street-community trust the precinct relies on.
23 June

Both teams chased down a Cotton On shoplifter who was arrested by Police on Waitematā Station Platform 1; across the same day Team 2 helped apprehend multiple shoplifters with $1,083.91 of goods recovered.
3 July

A welfare-first night: an unresponsive woman found off Tyler Street was safeguarded until authorities arrived, a man having seizures outside a nightclub was assisted until the ambulance came, and guards stepped in to stop a group of teens harassing an elderly man at Britomart.
4 July
Guards confiscated a switchblade from a 10-year-old who had made a violent threat at Britomart and held the situation safely until Police took him into custody.
5 July

Guards helped Police locate the OPSM break-in offender and issued a two-year trespass before the arrest; earlier the same day $368 of Peter Alexander stock was recovered within five minutes, and overnight a woman sheltering in a doorway was escorted to a warm, safe location.
8 July
Mountain Warehouse's stolen goods were recovered on Queen Street and the offender arrested; later that evening a Starbucks staff member who felt unsafe was escorted to her car.
12 July
An Ippondo offender was tracked on foot and onto a bus by a guard who stayed with him until Police made the arrest — guards then gave statements in support of the prosecution.
16 July
Guards witnessed an assault in progress on Queen Street, apprehended the assailant on the spot and assisted Police with the arrest.
